paragraphs: On Sunday morning, Dad opened his laptop. He looked at the weather for the day. "It is sunny and hot this morning," said Dad. "But a storm comes at three o'clock." "Can Ben and I ride to the lake?" asked Tom. "Yes, but come home before three," said Dad. Ben came to the door with his bike. Tom wore shorts, a white shirt, and a blue hat. Ben wore a yellow T-shirt and a red hat. Lily and Pip waved at the door.

The boys rode to the lake in the hot sun. They stopped under a big tree. Tom wanted to practice a new jump on his bike. "Watch me!" he said. At first, he fell on the grass. The second jump was bad too. "Don't move!" said Ben. "Is your leg OK?" "I'm fine," said Tom. He got up and tried again, and then he did it. Ben clapped and said, "You're a star!"

Then the wind came. The sky went gray, and it was cold. "It's half past two," said Ben. "We must go home." They rode home very quickly. Rain fell when they came to the door. "Move your bikes into the house!" said Dad. "It's dangerous to ride in a storm." In the evening, the storm ended, and everyone put on a sweater. Lily looked out of the window. "Can you see the stars?" she asked. Tom smiled and said, "Yes, it's a good night."
text.summary: Dad reads about a storm on his laptop. Tom and Ben ride to the lake in the hot sun and come home before the storm. In the evening, the family sees the stars.
